title: Find the deployed revision
brief: Find the shop application for the named environment. Open it, then find its deployed revision in History.

checks.question: Which Application matches the briefing?
checks.hint: Use the environment label on the Applications list.
checks.why: The list identifies which release to inspect before reading its history.

checks.question: Which Git revision is deployed?
checks.hint: Open History and Rollback and read Revision in the newest entry.
checks.why: History ties the deployed revision to a sync event.
